name: Shinobi Destiny
source:
You had an ominous dream. Under a blood-red moon, a gigantic emerald-colored serpent appeared and warned, “You must not awaken the sleeping one.” The words linger in your mind as you return to your daily life. However, one day, a wounded ninja named Hanzo appears, seeking your help for a crucial mission.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.ninjacol]Google Play[/url]]
